newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan August offshore banking assets edge up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan August offshore banking assets edge up.

text.p: The combined assets of Taiwan's 61 offshore banking units grew five percent to US$35.467 billion at the end of August from a year earlier, the central bank said on Wednesday.
About 77 percent of the assets, held by 34 local banks and 27 foreign banks, came from Asia and the rest from Europe and America, the bank said in a statement.
It said the bank recently approved an overseas banking unit application for a foreign bank and one for a local bank.
In August, Taiwan's OBUs reported a monthly foreign exchange turnover of $4.948 billion, the statement said.

Of the derivatives operated by the OBUs, margin trading accounted for $628 million, options took $226 million, financial futures accounted for $153 million, interest rate swaps took $34 million and forward interest rate agreement took $3 million.

The government has plans to expand OBU business in its scheme to become a regional financial centre. The expansion, although its size remains unspecified, would herald some tax burden for OBUs, officials have said.
